Legend of a mask

Source: R/mask.R
at_mask_legend.Rd

Legend of a mask

Usage

at_mask_legend(mask, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

mask

An annot_mask.

call

The calling environment, for error reporting.

Value

The mask's legend tibble::tibble (value, label, layer, roi_id, n_px, colour).

See also

Other masks: at_mask(), at_mask_boundary(), at_mask_preview(), at_mask_stack(), at_mask_stats(), at_read_mask(), at_write_mask(), at_write_masks()

Examples

at_mask_legend(at_mask(at_example_project(), "labelled"))
#> # A tibble: 3 × 6
#>   value label    layer   roi_id         n_px colour 
#>   <int> <chr>    <chr>   <chr>         <int> <chr>  
#> 1     1 tumour   regions roi_000000017 19600 #999999
#> 2     2 necrosis regions roi_000000018 72704 #E69F00
#> 3     3 stroma   regions roi_000000019 34200 #56B4E9
